story.title: Story 5: Detach Sources and Preserve Prior Provenance

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on convergence against SV-05-01 across the new shared active-source resolver, start/resume hydration-plan creation, rehydrate/rebuild planning, checkpoint source selection, and the directly touched regression tests.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: The touched runtime paths now reuse a shared active-source resolver that excludes detached rows and preserves process-scope shadowing (`apps/platform/server/services/processes/active-process-sources.ts:13-63`). That resolver is applied in process materials reads (`.../materials-section.reader.ts:82-117`), future hydration-plan creation for start/resume (`.../process-start.service.ts:57-81`, `.../process-resume.service.ts:58-82`), rehydrate/rebuild planning (`.../process-environment.service.ts:1269-1290`), and checkpoint source selection (`.../process-environment.service.ts:747-784`). The expanded Story 5 runtime test now proves detach leaves the already-persisted hydrated copy plan untouched while future rehydrate/rebuild plans drop the detached source and checkpoint writes are blocked (`tests/service/server/process-execution-orchestrator.test.ts:857-1063`). The focused follow-up test run and `corepack pnpm run green-verify` both passed.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/service/server/process-execution-orchestrator.test.ts tests/service/server/process-actions-api.test.ts tests/service/server/process-live-updates.test.ts tests/service/server/source-management-api.test.ts tests/service/client/source-management-ui.test.ts convex/sourceAttachments.test.ts convex/sourceProvenance.test.ts

additionalObservations: The fix is implemented in shared real server logic rather than a test-only workaround: the same active-source resolver now drives read surfaces and future runtime planning paths.
The full story gate passed after the follow-up changes, and the directly touched runtime regression suite passed with the new detach/rehydrate/rebuild/checkpoint assertions.
